scope: Seven current public Kaggriculture notebooks pulled with the authenticated Kaggle CLI. Notebooks were not executed; artifacts were recovered from AST-evaluated literals and decoded with standard-library base64/base85, zlib/lzma and path-checked tar readers.

notes: Large route/data literals and literal exec payloads were recursively decoded or parsed without executing policy code.
The only policy filesystem call found is a dead optional open(path) branch in the shared large-agent lineage where path is assigned None immediately before the guard.
The God Mode HTML files and Ice/Fire external dashboard dataset are analysis assets, not policy dependencies.

static_compare_order.why: Most lineage-diverse recovered policy: compact distilled trajectory, conditional score-bank branch, weed repair, feed-first opening and debt-tracked one-turn WHEAT/FERTILIZER sale splitting.
Compact generalized public-meta baseline ending in the R97 physical grain/supply guard; useful contrast to the much larger repeated market-closure lineage.
Canonical representative of the Step1009 family: it contains the near-identical Demand policy plus two empty-order guards and a fail-closed outer action boundary.

exact_existing_duplicates.scope: All four Python policy files and both HTML assets are byte-identical.

near_duplicate_families.delta: Harvest changes two SELL-block scans to tolerate empty orders and appends the 24-line V85 fail-closed interface guard.
Master changes the feed bonus calculation and adds the R88, R95 and R97 overlays; V31 ends at R86.

candidates.name: current-v31-bronze
candidates.packaging: Package main.py at archive root. Standard library only; no companion files.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 text and attribution are embedded in main.py.
candidates.source_structure: Direct %%writefile cell; no payload execution was needed.
key_mechanics: Shop-routed replay chassis with reactive storage, terminal rescue, tomato, sheep, input and market overlays.
R85 economic feed skipping and excess-fertilizer selling.
R86 only skips a feed when the next-day route still services that animal tile.
candidates.implementation_hypothesis: Useful only as an ablation of later Master overlays; its main.py is the older prefix of current-master-v53, not a new bronze-title strategy.
concerns: Notebook marketing is Version 31, while the extracted source header itself says independent confirmation is still required.
Subsumed by current-master-v53 except for one feed-bonus expression; low lineage diversity.
Notebook replay-analysis cells reference Kaggle input datasets, but those are not policy dependencies.
candidates.lineage: Public ShopRouter/Metav4/V39 family; 95.84% line-sequence overlap with current-master-v53.
candidates.priority: skip unless running a Master-layer ablation

candidates.name: current-demand-turn
candidates.packaging: Exact embedded tar.gz has flat members LICENSE.txt, NOTICE.txt and main.py.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 with a detailed NOTICE preserving ShopRouter, Metav4, engine-extract and later overlay attribution.
candidates.source_structure: A base85 literal contains the complete deterministic tar.gz; decoded statically and member paths were checked before writing.
key_mechanics: Large public-meta route/reaction stack with opponent sale-race estimation, physical input protection, terminal rescue and many narrow market overlays.
Final Step1009 wrapper applies the same inventory-safe _s793_reorder to Step1008, the forty-first fixed-SELL/fixed-order closure pass.
Every final pass updates the prior action cache when the market order sequence changes.
candidates.implementation_hypothesis: Tests whether an additional local order-search pass closes a residual market-order interaction; it does not introduce a new economic route or production policy.
concerns: Source comments label Step1008 and Step1009 HOLD and require full evaluation, contradicting notebook prose that calls Step1008 promoted.
Forty-one repeated applications of the same local reorder suggest very low marginal diversity and possible tuning to a narrow evaluation stream.
A dormant optional open(path) exists in the inherited V92 stream loader, but path is hard-coded to None; no network or subprocess code was found.
Near-duplicate of current-harvest and therefore not a distinct first-pass benchmark target.
candidates.lineage: Same giant Step1009 public-meta lineage as current-harvest; 99.86% line-sequence overlap.
candidates.priority: paired ablation only; prefer current-harvest as family representative

candidates.name: current-godmode
candidates.packaging: Place main.py, base_agent.py, shop_predictor.py and shop_overlay.py together at archive root. HTML files are not submission members. Benchmark with the bundle directory on sys.path.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 text and upstream notices are embedded in base_agent.py; no separate license file is present for the overlay modules.
candidates.source_structure: One lzma/base85 framed six-file bundle; all filenames, lengths and embedded SHA256 values were verified statically.
key_mechanics: 512 non-exhaustive seed particles consume observed weed/shop evidence, but future-shop inference is explicitly telemetry-only.

Actual policy change is seed-blind: defer up to eight units of an already planned sale when revealed-shop demand predicts at least a three-point price gain, then force settlement four-turn-block plus one later.
Only reserves when own visible production footprint is not behind the opponent and shed load remains below a soft cap.
candidates.implementation_hypothesis: The actionable mechanism is short revealed-demand sale deferral, not hidden-seed control; benchmark it only if that timing is absent from the existing parent.
concerns: The God Mode title overstates the runnable policy: sampled future-shop predictions never alter actions.
All six recovered files are byte-identical to latest-godmode, so this pull adds no candidate diversity.
The stateful controller is a module singleton and performs posterior filtering/telemetry work that may add per-turn cost without action benefit.
candidates.lineage: Existing latest-godmode exact duplicate; base_agent is the same large public V39/meta family.

candidates.name: current-ice-fire
candidates.packaging: Package main.py alone at archive root. The three dashboard files referenced by article mode are external analysis assets and are not runtime dependencies.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 text and upstream attribution are embedded in main.py.
candidates.source_structure: One lzma/base85 main.py literal with an expected source hash; decoded statically.
key_mechanics: Large V39/public-meta parent plus an EarlyCycle opening that turns idle early actions into a temporary wheat crop.
Final MarketShock-M1-WR1K layer fingerprints the complete public and private observation at step 506 and replaces the farmer route through step 527 only for one stored scenario.
Unknown observations pass through bit-for-bit.
candidates.implementation_hypothesis: Useful as a narrow memorization/route-repair diagnostic, not as evidence of general flexibility; activation outside its exact recorded world should be effectively zero.
concerns: The final water repair key includes full farm, private, market and town state, making it an exact replay-state patch with weak expected transfer.
Notebook analysis of fixed versus flexible play does not describe a broadly adaptive final policy.
Shares 73.08% line-sequence overlap with current-demand-turn before its final specialized patch.
candidates.lineage: Large public-meta lineage with a distinct but single-scenario exact-state tail patch.
candidates.priority: low; benchmark only as an overfit control

candidates.name: current-harvest
candidates.packaging: Flat archive with main.py, LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0; full license supplied and NOTICE points to the public top-2 parent while main.py retains upstream notices.
candidates.source_structure: Three independent zlib/base85 file literals, each checked against an embedded SHA256.
key_mechanics: Same Step1009 repeated fixed-SELL closure stack as current-demand-turn.
Two inherited SELL-block scans additionally tolerate empty market orders.
V85 returns valid parent actions by identity and replaces only exceptions or malformed top-level action containers with correctly hand-sized PASS actions.
candidates.implementation_hypothesis: The V85 delta can prevent catastrophic invalid-action termination but cannot improve ordinary game economics; any score gain over Demand should come from rare failure avoidance.
concerns: The parent still contains source comments marking Step1008/Step1009 HOLD despite notebook claims of a proven line.
V85 validates only container types, not command legality, arity or hand-count consistency.
Fallback sizing reads observation outside the try block, so severely malformed observations can still raise.
Near-duplicate of current-demand-turn; use this one as the single family representative.
candidates.lineage: Canonical current representative of the giant Step1009 public-meta family; 99.86% overlap with Demand.
candidates.priority: high within its family, but only one of Harvest/Demand should enter broad comparison

candidates.name: current-multiroute
candidates.entrypoint: c94_submission_agent (the final callable; module.agent is its parent implementation)
candidates.packaging: Package main.py alone at archive root. Standard library only.
candidates.license: Notebook claims Apache-2.0 attribution is retained, but neither main.py nor its decoded embedded branch contains an Apache/SPDX/license notice; retain the notebook as provenance and treat licensing as incomplete.
candidates.source_structure: Outer zlib/base64 main.py literal. main.py contains a second zlib/base85 Python branch (41382 bytes, SHA256 aef493e6b0b898a6b5ea88db0b51bb96b4e5864ba559caeb51429201cd539932) executed at import; it was decoded and recursively AST-scanned without execution.
key_mechanics: Distilled Lev Neganov episode trace with front-run sales, terminal liquidation and an observation-driven final-eight-turn controller.
After step 408, switches to an embedded score-bank-tuned trajectory branch when the bank lead is at most 250.
Repairs productive routes around weeds, buys five WHEAT first at step 0, and advances capped one-turn WHEAT/FERTILIZER sales while recording debt to reduce the original next-turn sale.
candidates.implementation_hypothesis: Highest-diversity recovery candidate: its compact trajectory, conditional branch and one-turn commodity-sale split may respond differently to the live opponents that defeated recent submissions.
concerns: Notebook calls the payload C95, but recovered code's final callable and final layer are explicitly c94_submission_agent/C94.
Trajectory is distilled from one named episode, so shop/opponent transfer remains a substantive risk.
Uses runtime exec(compile(decoded_source)) for the embedded branch; static recursion found no network, filesystem or subprocess behavior.
Some state is module-global, though per-seat debt dictionaries are used in the final layer.
candidates.lineage: Distinct compact trajectory/controller lineage rather than the giant Step1009/V39 source stack.

candidates.name: current-master-v53
candidates.packaging: Package main.py alone at archive root; notebook names the archive submission_competitive_v39.tar.gz.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 text and extensive public-source attribution are embedded in main.py.
candidates.source_structure: Direct %%writefile main.py cell. Literal unit/planner exec strings and compressed route JSON were parsed statically.
key_mechanics: Shop-routed replay chassis with sale lead/suppression, terminal physical planner, storage guard, tomato expansion, sheep branch and input harvesting.
R88 counts feed/care phase value before economic feed skipping.

R95 reserves two days of physical WHEAT demand; R97 protects funded pickup/feed supply by holding sales or inserting a bounded BUY_PRODUCT WHEAT while preserving order indices and budget/capacity constraints.
candidates.implementation_hypothesis: A smaller, more general policy to test against the live-loss pattern: input continuity and physical grain protection may be more robust than dozens of marginal SELL-order closure passes.
concerns: Naming is inconsistent: Kaggle id says Master Engine V5/v53, markdown says Master Engine V2, startup text/archive say V39, and source ends at R97.
R97 applies only under standard configuration and catches exceptions by returning the parent action.
It remains the same public ShopRouter/V39 ancestry as the larger candidates, so it is not fully independent.
candidates.lineage: Compact public V39/R97 branch; supersedes current-v31-bronze and is an ancestor/prefix of the larger Demand/Harvest lineage.
candidates.priority: high as a compact generalized contrast
